view.name: Substantive Reply Watch
view.description: Lean X reply watch for creators. Surfaces only new substantive replies that need the owner — real questions, pushback, corrections, or requests for their take — and stays quiet otherwise.

memory.content: Lean X reply watch: alert only on new substantive replies to the owner's posts from the last 24 hours, or to the owner's own replies in those threads. Deduplicate by last-seen reply ids. Stay silent when nothing needs the owner.

Substantive means a real question, pushback, correction, claim that needs an answer, or a clear request for the owner's take — not thanks-only, emoji-only, empty agreement, spam, or "nice post" fluff.
This bot needs the X (Twitter) connector connected so it can read the owner's posts and mentions.
